mainEntity.name: What kind of digital product should I create with AI first—a course, ebook, templates, or prompts?

acceptedAnswer.text: A practical first product is usually a focused guide, checklist, template pack, short workshop, email course, or mini-course that solves one clearly described problem. The best format depends on how much explanation, customization, and ongoing support buyers need. Context: Run My AI Biz covers course planning, presentations, lesson scripts, videos, lead magnets, and supporting sales materials. Key factors: customer skill level, desired result, update frequency, production time, and whether buyers need examples or feedback. Practical guidance: match the format to the customer’s next action—for example, a checklist for a repeatable task or a mini-course for a skill requiring explanation. Draft a product outline with AI, then add original examples, instructions, and quality checks. Run My AI Biz can help compare formats before you commit to a larger build.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose the format that best fits the customer’s problem. Use templates or checklists for repeatable tasks, a guide for explanation, and a course when buyers need structured teaching. Start with a small version and add complexity only after feedback shows it is needed.
